content.comment_body: How can I connect analog transmitters to the digital inputs (I7 and I8) of the [product_name]? Is it only possible to connect 3-wire transmitters, or can 2-wire transmitters be used too? Any advice would be appreciated.
You might find some useful information here: [url]

Only sensors outputting 0 (or 2) to 10 Volt, which are usually 3-wire, can be connected directly. If you have a sensor outputting 0 (or 4) to 20 mA (typically 2-wire), you can use it as well by connecting a 500 Ohm resistor between the analog input of the [product_name] and the negative terminal of the power supply. One wire from the sensor should go to the analog input—the same point as the resistor connection—and the other wire must be connected to the positive terminal of the power supply.
A new question posted by [user_name] was moved to a different thread regarding wiring diagrams for transmitter, controller, and resistor. Best regards, [user_name]

analysis.insight_summary: Users are looking for guidance on connecting both 2-wire and 3-wire analog transmitters to the digital inputs of the [product_name] module. Responses clarify compatibility: 0(2)-10V sensors (typically 3-wire) can be connected directly, while 0(4)-20mA sensors (generally 2-wire) require appropriate wiring with a 500 Ohm resistor. Confusion appears to come from inadequate documentation or practical wiring examples.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect clear and practical instructions for wiring different types of analog transmitters to the digital input terminals of the [product_name] module.
